description: List every optic with a cited fit on one pistol, each marked direct (with footprint) or adapter (with the plate chain in via). Use it for questions like "what red dots fit my pistol". Optics not listed have no cited fit, which is not evidence they do not fit. Report the answer exactly as returned: never call an adapter fit a direct fit, and never turn "unknown" into "does not fit". Cite with the returned citation line and link html_url.

fit.description: Only direct fits, only adapter-plate fits, or both (default).

pistol.description: Pistol slug (e.g. "taurus/g3-toro") or name (e.g. "Taurus G3 TORO").

name: list_optics_for_pistol
title: List optics for a pistol
